title: Money: Rand and Cents to R100
seo_title: Grade 2 Money Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Recognise and identify the South African coins and bank notes; solve money problems involving totals and change in rands and cents, up to R99.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 2 maths worksheets: rand coins and notes, counting money, shopping and change to R100. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Coins: 10c, 20c, 50c, R1, R2, R5. Notes: R10, R20, R50, R100, R200.
  • Count from the biggest coin or note down.
  • Shopping: add the prices.
  • Change: take the price away from what you paid.

Examples

Example

Pay R20 for R13

R20 − R13

Answer: R7 change

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting coinsAdd the values.
ChangeSubtract the price.
Cents and rands100c = R1.
